The '''Kishpaugh system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Nelvana Gas Cluster/Legends|Nelvana Gas Cluster]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kishpaugh]].
